{{NPCs by Location List|Honami Central Park}} 

==City Secrets==
''Unlocked by finding all Missing Namipons in [[Namipon Case Files]]''

Contrary to popular memory, the park around Neon Tower predates the tower itself. In fact, Neon Tower was sited here precisely because the park's open grounds would minimise radio intereference. After the tower's completion, the original Honami City Park was expanded into Honami Central Park, a proud symbol of the city centre. At the time, it also stood as the largest park in all of Ashinohara.

Its first urban legend came shortly after staff began hanging fish windsocks. One morning, they discovered that every windsock, once scattered across the park, had gathered above the innermost garden. Not long after, the Pioneer Association published a grainy, shocking video captured by a citizen staying late there one night: under the moonlight, many windsocks glided through the sky toward a single spot, as if they were alive...
